quandoUsar: The main call to action of a marketing page or the end of a section, with `ArrowButton` (“Start free trial”) or `MagneticButton` (“Schedule a demo”).
Confirming something that should not happen from an accidental tap, like a payment, with `SlideToConfirm`.
quandoEvitar: Use `button` for common interface actions, like forms, dialogs, and toolbars; these three are showcase buttons.
Use `hold-to-confirm` or `confirm-morph` when the confirmation needs to fit in a button-sized control: `SlideToConfirm` is a 52 px tall track that takes the parent's width.

teclado.acao: On `ArrowButton` and `MagneticButton`, trigger the button; with `href` they are links and respond only to `Enter`.
On `SlideToConfirm`, with focus on the thumb, confirm directly, without dragging.

acessibilidade: `ArrowButton` and `MagneticButton` are native `<button>`, or `<a>` when they get `href`; on `ArrowButton`, the colored copy of the label is `aria-hidden`, and the name is the children's text.

On `SlideToConfirm`, the thumb is a button with an `aria-label` equal to `label` (afterward, `confirmedLabel`); keyboard activation confirms without dragging, and a `role="status"` announces the confirmation.
The track text is `aria-hidden` and the defaults are in English (“Slide to confirm”, “Confirmed”): write the whole action in `label`, like “Slide to pay R$ 48”.
movimento: `ArrowButton`: on hover, keyboard focus, or press, the arrow disc grows to cover the button (0.48 s), the label changes color at the fill edge, and a new arrow enters from the left.
`MagneticButton`: with the mouse within `reach` px, the button follows the cursor on a loose spring, with a slight sway on return, and the label moves a bit further; touch and pen move nothing.

`SlideToConfirm`: the thumb arrows nudge every 1.8 s and releasing before `threshold` (90%) returns it on a spring; with “reduce motion”, none of this animates, the magnet stops, and `ArrowButton` fills with no transition.
responsivo: `SlideToConfirm` takes the parent's width up to `20rem` and measures the track with an observer, so the thumb travel adjusts; with `touch-action: pan-y`, vertical scrolling still works over it.
On `ArrowButton`, the label does not wrap and ends in an ellipsis when space runs out.
desempenho: Each `MagneticButton` listens to `pointermove` on the whole window and measures its own position on every mouse move; use few per page.
notasIA: They are three exports from the same file: `import ArrowButton, { MagneticButton, SlideToConfirm } from "@/components/ryan-ui/cta-buttons/cta-buttons"` (the default is `ArrowButton`).

On `SlideToConfirm`, the action goes in `onConfirm`, which runs once (a simple tap only wiggles the thumb); to control it, use `confirmed` with `onConfirmedChange`, and `resetAfter` to return to the start on its own.

`ArrowButton` and `MagneticButton` become links with `href`; `ArrowButton` accepts `icon` in place of the arrow and `size` `md` or `lg`, and `MagneticButton` accepts `strength` (0 turns off the magnet) and `reach`.
